title: Sustained Performance and Energy Accounting for Nonlinear Forecasting Across Classical and Simulated Quantum Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.25183v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Energy-efficient AI should be evaluated across the full application pipeline, not only by lowest error or shortest training time. We study this through nonlinear time-series forecasting using simulated quantum reservoir computing (QRC) as an emerging-computing case study. Our evaluation spans 33 forecasting configurations and 825 completed runs on NARMA-10, NARMA-20, Mackey--Glass, Lorenz-63, and Santa Fe laser data. The core benchmark includes 775 fully instrumented runs across statistical, linear, reservoir, neural, continuous-variable Gaussian QRC, and gate-based statevector QRC models, with 50 additional variational QNN runs extending the trainable-quantum comparison.   We measure NRMSE, RMSE, MAE, wall time, inference latency, peak CPU/GPU memory, parameter count, operational energy, and carbon. translated_title: 经典模型与模拟量子模型在非线性预测中的持续性能与能耗核算
translated_abstract: 高能效人工智能应当在完整的应用流程中进行评估，而不仅仅以最低误差或最短训练时间为标准。我们通过非线性时间序列预测来研究这一问题，并将模拟量子储备池计算（QRC）作为新兴计算技术的案例研究。我们的评估涵盖33种预测配置以及在NARMA-10、NARMA-20、Mackey-Glass、Lorenz-63和Santa Fe激光数据集上完成的825次运行。核心基准包括775次全程监测的运行，涵盖统计模型、线性模型、储备池模型、神经网络模型、连续变量高斯QRC以及基于门的态矢量QRC模型，另有50次变分量子神经网络（QNN）运行以扩展可训练量子模型的比较。我们测量了NRMSE、RMSE、MAE、实际运行时间、推理延迟、CPU/GPU峰值内存、参数量、运行能耗及碳排放。由于固定的QRC编码器可以为多个读出层生成可复用的特征，我们同时报告了冷启动成本和摊销成本。
tldr: 该论文通过在经典模型与模拟量子模型（包括量子储备池计算）上开展大规模非线性时间序列预测基准测试，从误差、延迟、内存、能耗和碳排放等多个维度全面核算了AI系统的持续性能与能效。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts large-scale nonlinear time-series forecasting benchmarks across classical and simulated quantum models (including quantum reservoir computing), comprehensively accounting for sustained performance and energy efficiency in terms of error, latency, memory, energy consumption, and carbon emissions.
